# stb_image

`stb_image.h` is vendored from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb)
at commit `003501f6d7a8668ce8b6d875e34dd97ad0d5d5b5`.
Its MIT/public-domain dual license is included at the end of the header.
Vertex uses the MIT license option. Only memory-based PNG, JPEG and GIF decoding
is enabled. Builds do not download dependencies.
